name: Kolkar Leaders
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years.  And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat.  Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them.  Rallying them.

To preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.

Bring me the head of Barak Kodobane.  He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north.

Defeat him, then return to me.
narrative.objectives: Bring Barak's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well done, adventurer. The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead. And those are the most dangerous.

Barak was such a centaur. It is good that he is dead.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello, adventurer. Do you have Barak's Head for me?
